description: This Java class 'PortUnificationHandler' handles protocol detection and switching in a Netty server, supporting HTTP, HTTP/2, SOCKS4/5, TLS, and proxy connections within the MockServer project.

classes.name: PortUnificationHandler
classes.description: A Netty handler that detects protocol type (HTTP, HTTP/2, TLS, SOCKS, proxy) and switches the pipeline accordingly for the MockServer project.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Main decoding method that detects protocol and switches pipeline handlers accordingly.

methods.name: logStage
methods.description: Logs the current decoding stage if TRACE level is enabled.

methods.name: isTls
methods.description: Checks if the ByteBuf contains TLS-encrypted data.

methods.name: enableTls
methods.description: Enables TLS protocol handling by adding SniHandler.

methods.name: isHttp
methods.description: Detects if ByteBuf contains an HTTP request based on method string.

methods.name: switchToHttp2
methods.description: Switches pipeline to HTTP/2 protocol handlers.

methods.name: switchToHttp
methods.description: Switches pipeline to HTTP/1.1 protocol handlers.

methods.name: isProxyConnected
methods.description: Detects if the message indicates a proxy connection.

methods.name: switchToProxyConnected
methods.description: Configures pipeline for proxy connection handling.

methods.name: switchToBinaryRequestProxying
methods.description: Configures pipeline for binary request proxying.

methods.name: getLocalAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves or calculates local addresses for the channel.

methods.name: calculatePortExtension
methods.description: Calculates port extension string based on port and SSL status.

methods.name: calculateLocalAddresses
methods.description: Generates set of local address strings for the channel.

methods.name: addLastIfNotPresent
methods.description: Adds handler to pipeline if not already present.

methods.name: exceptionCaught
methods.description: Handles exceptions, logs TLS handshake issues, and closes channel if needed.
